This notebook documents the four Trip-5 metagenome-assembled genomes
(MAGs) that classify in GTDB r226 as `f__CSP1-2` within
`p__Desulfobakterota_D; c__UBA1144; o__UBA2774`. The upstream
compute (GTDB-Tk on 3,108 Trip-5 bins; CheckM2; GSPA
DIAMOND-vs-SwissProt annotation) is documented in
`scripts/slurm/gtdbtk_trip5.sbatch` and
`scripts/slurm/csp_mag2.sbatch`; outputs are cached under
`cache/csp_mags/` and `cache/gspa_out/`.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
```

## Panel A — CheckM2 completeness / contamination

```{python}
#| label: fig8a-quality
# Values produced by the CheckM2 run on unimatrix.
checkm = pd.DataFrame([
    {"MAG": "V30PRr1__SemiBin_7",  "compartment": "rhizosphere",
     "completeness": 80.09, "contamination": 1.10, "size_mb": 2.67, "gc": 43.2, "cds": 2905},
    {"MAG": "V27Dr2__SemiBin_73",  "compartment": "deep",
     "completeness": 70.88, "contamination": 2.83, "size_mb": 2.66, "gc": 43.1, "cds": 2859},
    {"MAG": "V38PRr3__SemiBin_38", "compartment": "rhizosphere",
     "completeness": 64.71, "contamination": 1.26, "size_mb": 2.34, "gc": 43.0, "cds": 2546},
    {"MAG": "V32PRr1__SemiBin_26", "compartment": "rhizosphere",
     "completeness": 61.29, "contamination": 1.10, "size_mb": 1.98, "gc": 43.3, "cds": 2128},
]).set_index("MAG")
checkm.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "csp_mags_checkm2.tsv", sep="\t")
checkm
```

```{python}
#| label: fig8a-plot
palette = {"rhizosphere": "#2ca02c", "deep": "#1f77b4", "surface": "#d62728"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
for i, (name, row) in enumerate(checkm.iterrows()):
    c = palette[row["compartment"]]
    ax.barh(i, row["completeness"], color=c, edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.4)
    ax.text(row["completeness"] + 1, i,
            f"{row['completeness']:.1f} % / {row['contamination']:.1f} % cont.",
            va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(checkm))); ax.set_yticklabels(checkm.index)
ax.set_xlabel("CheckM2 completeness (%)"); ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.axvline(50, linestyle="--", color="grey", lw=0.5)
ax.axvline(90, linestyle=":", color="grey", lw=0.5)
ax.set_title("MIMAG medium-quality (≥ 50 %) or better")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig8a_checkm2.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Panel B — GSPA functional signature (DIAMOND vs Swiss-Prot)

```{python}
#| label: fig8b-gspa
# Consolidated counts across 4 MAGs (from grep over gspa_out/*/annotations.tsv)
gspa = pd.DataFrame([
    {"MAG": "V30PRr1__SemiBin_7",  "annotated": 1068, "total": 2500,
     "vnfA": 3, "anfA": 3, "nifHDK": 0, "nitrate_red": 7,
     "trehalose": 18, "uvr_rec_ssb": 60},
    {"MAG": "V27Dr2__SemiBin_73",  "annotated": 1075, "total": 2424,
     "vnfA": 4, "anfA": 3, "nifHDK": 0, "nitrate_red": 0,
     "trehalose": 17, "uvr_rec_ssb": 70},
    {"MAG": "V32PRr1__SemiBin_26", "annotated":  771, "total": 1772,
     "vnfA": 3, "anfA": 4, "nifHDK": 0, "nitrate_red": 0,
     "trehalose": 22, "uvr_rec_ssb": 60},
    {"MAG": "V38PRr3__SemiBin_38", "annotated":  935, "total": 2146,
     "vnfA": 2, "anfA": 2, "nifHDK": 0, "nitrate_red": 7,
     "trehalose": 21, "uvr_rec_ssb": 90},
]).set_index("MAG")
gspa["dark_pct"] = 100 * (1 - gspa["annotated"] / gspa["total"])
gspa.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "csp_mags_gspa_summary.tsv", sep="\t")
gspa
```

```{python}
#| label: fig8b-plot
cats = ["vnfA", "anfA", "nifHDK", "nitrate_red", "trehalose", "uvr_rec_ssb"]
data = gspa[cats]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.8))
x = np.arange(len(cats))
w = 0.2
colors = ["#2ca02c", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#d62728"]
for i, (name, row) in enumerate(data.iterrows()):
    ax.bar(x + (i - 1.5) * w, row.values, w, label=name, color=colors[i])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cats, rotation=20)
ax.set_ylabel("gene-copies (DIAMOND, ≥ 30 % id)")
ax.set_title("CSP1-2 MAG functional signature (consistent across 4 MAGs)")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7, loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig8b_functional.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Panel C — dark-matter fraction per MAG

```{python}
#| label: fig8c-darkmatter
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3))
ax.barh(gspa.index, gspa["dark_pct"], color="#555555", edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.4)
for i, v in enumerate(gspa["dark_pct"]):
    ax.text(v + 0.5, i, f"{v:.1f} %", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("dark-matter fraction (no DIAMOND hit to SwissProt ≥30 % id)")
ax.set_xlim(0, 80)
ax.set_title("~55–65 % of CSP1-2 proteins lack SwissProt hits")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig8c_darkmatter.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

      f"nifHDK absent; 2/4 MAGs carry 7 nitrate-reductase homologues.")
print(f"  Trehalose synthase: {gspa['trehalose'].min()}–{gspa['trehalose'].max()} copies per MAG.")
print(f"  DNA repair (UvrABC/RecA/SSB): {gspa['uvr_rec_ssb'].min()}–{gspa['uvr_rec_ssb'].max()} copies per MAG.")
